title: Indole metabolites produced by Lactobacillus acidophilus impedes bisphenol F- aryl hydrocarbon receptor interaction and ameliorates bisphenol F induced depression-like changes.
authors: Hu, Miaoyang; Manglike, Ayiguzaili; Li, Xiaozhu; Wei, Jin; Lou, Xinyu; Liu, Jing; Tang, Zhiru; He, Weiping; Ji, Guixiang; Wang, Wenjuan; Ma, Tengfei; Gao, Rong; Wang, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肠道菌群吲哚代谢物与芳香烃受体(AHR)的分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作，但对象非蛋白质-DNA体系，且方法仅用分子对接，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
abstract: Bisphenol F (BPF), a major bisphenol A substitute widely used in packaging and pharmaceuticals, poses emerging neuropsychiatric risks with unknown mechanisms. Here, we first linked elevated urinary BPF in newly diagnosed depressed patients to human depressive phenotypes. In mice, we found that BPF exposure resulted in depletion of Lactobacillus acidophilus (L. acidophilus), whose transplantation obviously reversed the depression-like behaviors. With the Multi-omics (16S rRNA sequencing, untargeted/targeted metabolomics) assays, we revealed the two key reduced target metabolites produced by L. acidophilus, indole-3-lactic acid (ILA) and indole-3-acetic acid (IAA). Exogenous supplementation of ILA/IAA strikingly rescued the BPF-induced depressive behaviors. Mechanistically, the molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis results showed that BPF serves as a novel exogenous aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) ligand, competing with ILA/IAA at MET109/LEU110 to activate cytochrome P450 1B1 (CYP1B1) signaling; Critically, knockout of AHR in mice (AHR(-/-)) substantially impeded the BPF induced depression like behaviors, CYP1B1 activation and microglia mediated abnormal synaptic pruning. Collectively, the present study uncovers a novel "microbiota-indole metabolite-AHR-CYP1B1" axis mediating BPF-induced depressive changes, supporting targeted interventions (e.g., L.acidophilus) transplantation, ILA/IAA supplementation, AHR modulation) as potential therapies for neuropsychiatric disorders induced by BPF.
abstract_zh: 双酚F（BPF）作为双酚A的主要替代品，广泛用于包装和医药领域，其引发的神经精神风险尚属新兴问题，机制未明。本研究中，我们首先将新诊断抑郁症患者尿液中升高的BPF与人类抑郁表型相关联。在小鼠实验中，我们发现BPF暴露导致嗜酸乳杆菌（L. acidophilus）耗竭，而移植该菌能明显逆转抑郁样行为。通过多组学分析（16S rRNA测序、非靶向/靶向代谢组学），我们揭示了嗜酸乳杆菌产生的两种关键减少的代谢物：吲哚-3-乳酸（ILA）和吲哚-3-乙酸（IAA）。外源性补充ILA/IAA显著缓解了BPF诱导的抑郁行为。机制上，分子对接和微量热泳动结果显示，BPF作为一种新型外源性芳烃受体（AHR）配体，在MET109/LEU110位点与ILA/IAA竞争，激活细胞色素P450 1B1（CYP1B1）信号通路；关键的是，小鼠中敲除AHR（AHR(-/-)）显著阻断了BPF诱导的抑郁样行为、CYP1B1激活及小胶质细胞介导的异常突触修剪。综上，本研究揭示了一条新的“微生物群-吲哚代谢物-AHR-CYP1B1”轴介导BPF诱导的抑郁变化，支持靶向干预（如嗜酸乳杆菌移植、ILA/IAA补充、AHR调节）作为BPF所致神经精神障碍的潜在治疗策略。
